from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup initial layout
        lines = [
            "How do we trace infections without tracking people?",
            "Traditional tracing creates a central map of movements.",
            "DP-3T offers a decentralized, privacy-first alternative."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("The Privacy Dilemma (0:45)", lines)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Colors line 1
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        
        # Create Alice and Bob dots
        alice = Dot(color="#3498DB")
        bob = Dot(color="#E67E22")
        alice_label = Text("Alice", font_size=16, color="#3498DB")
        bob_label = Text("Bob", font_size=16, color="#E67E22")

        # Initial placement
        self.place_at_grid(alice, "C2")
        self.place_at_grid(bob, "D5")
        alice_label.next_to(alice, UP, buff=0.1)
        bob_label.next_to(bob, UP, buff=0.1)

        self.play(
            FadeIn(alice), FadeIn(bob),
            FadeIn(alice_label), FadeIn(bob_label)
        )

        # Alice and Bob wander
        self.play(
            alice.animate.move_to(self.grid["B2"]),
            alice_label.animate.next_to(self.grid["B2"], UP, buff=0.1),
            bob.animate.move_to(self.grid["E5"]),
            bob_label.animate.next_to(self.grid["E5"], UP, buff=0.1),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=linear
        )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Highlight line 2 in Red to match the eye
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#E74C3C")
        
        # Create a central "Eye" server
        eye_white = Ellipse(width=1.4, height=0.7, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1)
        eye_iris = Dot(radius=0.2, color="#E74C3C")
        central_eye = VGroup(eye_white, eye_iris)
        self.place_at_grid(central_eye, "C4", scale_factor=0.8)

        self.play(FadeIn(central_eye))
        
        # Eye "watches" Alice and Bob
        self.play(
            eye_iris.animate.move_to(eye_white.get_center() + LEFT * 0.25),
            alice.animate.move_to(self.grid["B1"]),
            alice_label.animate.next_to(self.grid["B1"], UP, buff=0.1),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.play(
            eye_iris.animate.move_to(eye_white.get_center() + RIGHT * 0.25),
            bob.animate.move_to(self.grid["F6"]),
            bob_label.animate.next_to(self.grid["F6"], UP, buff=0.1),
            run_time=1.5
        )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Highlight line 3 in Blue to match the shield
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#3498DB")
        
        # Privacy Shield replaces the eye
        shield_shape = VMobject()
        shield_shape.set_points_as_corners([
            [-0.5, 0.6, 0], [0.5, 0.6, 0], [0.5, 0, 0], [0, -0.7, 0], [-0.5, 0, 0], [-0.5, 0.6, 0]
        ])
        shield = shield_shape.set_fill("#3498DB", opacity=0.8).set_stroke(WHITE, width=2)
        self.place_at_grid(shield, "C4", scale_factor=0.8)

        self.play(FadeOut(central_eye), FadeIn(shield))
        
        # Alice and Bob exchange Ephemeral IDs (Glowing yellow dots)
        id_a = Dot(radius=0.1, color="#F1C40F")
        id_b = Dot(radius=0.1, color="#F1C40F")
        
        # Move dots to people then exchange
        id_a.move_to(alice.get_center())
        id_b.move_to(bob.get_center())
        
        self.play(FadeIn(id_a), FadeIn(id_b))
        
        # Paths for exchange
        self.play(
            id_a.animate.move_to(bob.get_center()),
            id_b.animate.move_to(alice.get_center()),
            alice.animate.move_to(self.grid["D2"]),
            alice_label.animate.next_to(self.grid["D2"], UP, buff=0.1),
            bob.animate.move_to(self.grid["D5"]),
            bob_label.animate.next_to(self.grid["D5"], UP, buff=0.1),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        self.play(FadeOut(id_a), FadeOut(id_b))

        # Final title "DP-3T"
        dp3t_title = Text("DP-3T", font_size=42, color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(dp3t_title, "C4")
        
        self.play(
            FadeOut(shield),
            FadeIn(dp3t_title)
        )
        self.wait(2)

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Title and Lecture lines setup
        title_str = "Prerequisite: The Digital Shredder (Hashing) (0:45)"
        lines_str = [
            "A secret seed generates unique, temporary IDs.",
            "Hashing is like a mathematical one-way blender.",
            "IDs are public, but the seed stays hidden."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title_str, lines_str)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # A seed icon (#E67E22) labeled "Secret Seed" enters a blender graphic (#95A5A6).
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#E67E22")
        
        seed_icon = Dot(radius=0.4, color="#E67E22")
        seed_label = Text("Secret Seed", font_size=18, color="#E67E22")
        seed_group = VGroup(seed_icon, seed_label).arrange(UP, buff=0.2)
        self.place_at_grid(seed_group, "A4")
        
        # Simple Blender graphic: A trapezoid and a lid
        blender_body = Polygon(
            [-0.8, 1, 0], [0.8, 1, 0], [0.5, -1, 0], [-0.5, -1, 0],
            color="#95A5A6", fill_opacity=0.3, stroke_width=4
        )
        blender_lid = Line([-0.9, 1, 0], [0.9, 1, 0], color="#95A5A6", stroke_width=8)
        blender = VGroup(blender_body, blender_lid)
        self.place_in_area(blender, "C3", "D5", scale_factor=1.2)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(blender))
        self.play(FadeIn(seed_group))
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Animation: Seed enters the blender
        self.play(
            seed_group.animate.move_to(blender.get_center()).scale(0.5).set_opacity(0),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.wait(0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Three different alphanumeric strings (#1ABC9C) emerge from the blender.
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#1ABC9C")
        
        id1 = Text("0x8F2A", font_size=20, color="#1ABC9C")
        id2 = Text("0x3C1B", font_size=20, color="#1ABC9C")
        id3 = Text("0x7E9D", font_size=20, color="#1ABC9C")
        
        # Starting positions inside the blender bottom
        ids = VGroup(id1, id2, id3)
        for mob in ids:
            mob.move_to(self.grid["D4"])
            mob.set_opacity(0)
        
        # Animation: IDs "flow" out of the bottom of the blender
        self.play(
            id1.animate.move_to(self.grid["F3"]).set_opacity(1),
            id2.animate.move_to(self.grid["F4"]).set_opacity(1),
            id3.animate.move_to(self.grid["F5"]).set_opacity(1),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=slow_into
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # A red arrow (#E74C3C) pointing back from IDs to Seed is crossed out to show one-way hashing.
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#E74C3C")
        
        # Red arrow from IDs back up to the seed's original position
        reverse_arrow = Arrow(
            start=self.grid["F4"], 
            end=self.grid["A4"], 
            color="#E74C3C", 
            stroke_width=8, 
            buff=0.4
        )
        
        # Big Red Cross (X) over the arrow to show "Impossible"
        cross_line1 = Line(UP+LEFT, DOWN+RIGHT, color="#E74C3C", stroke_width=12).scale(0.6)
        cross_line2 = Line(UP+RIGHT, DOWN+LEFT, color="#E74C3C", stroke_width=12).scale(0.6)
        cross = VGroup(cross_line1, cross_line2)
        self.place_at_grid(cross, "D4")
        
        self.play(Create(reverse_arrow))
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(Create(cross))
        self.wait(2)

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Phones broadcast temporary IDs via Bluetooth signals.",
            "Alice’s phone generates a new ID every fifteen minutes.",
            "Bob’s phone records Alice’s ID in a local log.",
            "No locations or names are ever exchanged.",
            "These secret handshakes stay only on your device."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Phase 1: The Daily Handshake (1:00)", lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors
        ALICE_COLOR = "#3498DB"
        BOB_COLOR = "#E67E22"
        BT_RANGE_COLOR = "#5DADE2"
        CLOCK_COLOR = "#FFFFFF"
        ID_COLOR = "#F1C40F"
        LOG_COLOR = "#2ECC71"

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Phones broadcast temporary IDs via Bluetooth signals.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(ALICE_COLOR)
        
        alice_phone = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.1, height=1.0, width=0.6, color=ALICE_COLOR)
        self.place_at_grid(alice_phone, "C2")
        alice_label = Text("Alice", font_size=18, color=ALICE_COLOR)
        self.place_at_grid(alice_label, "B2")
        
        bob_phone = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.1, height=1.0, width=0.6, color=BOB_COLOR)
        self.place_at_grid(bob_phone, "C5")
        bob_label = Text("Bob", font_size=18, color=BOB_COLOR)
        self.place_at_grid(bob_label, "B5")
        
        bt_range = Circle(radius=2.2, color=BT_RANGE_COLOR, stroke_width=2).set_opacity(0.3)
        self.place_in_area(bt_range, "A1", "F6")
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(alice_phone), FadeIn(alice_label),
            FadeIn(bob_phone), FadeIn(bob_label),
            Create(bt_range)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Alice’s phone generates a new ID every fifteen minutes.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(CLOCK_COLOR)
        
        clock_circle = Circle(radius=0.3, color=CLOCK_COLOR)
        clock_hand = Line(ORIGIN, UP * 0.25, color=CLOCK_COLOR)
        clock = VGroup(clock_circle, clock_hand)
        self.place_at_grid(clock, "A4")
        
        id_a = Text("ID-A", font_size=20, color=ID_COLOR)
        self.place_at_grid(id_a, "C2") # Over Alice's phone
        
        self.play(FadeIn(clock))
        self.play(Rotate(clock_hand, angle=-TAU, about_point=clock_circle.get_center()), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Write(id_a))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Bob’s phone records Alice’s ID in a local log.
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(LOG_COLOR)
        
        log_box = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.05, height=1.2, width=0.8, color=LOG_COLOR)
        self.place_at_grid(log_box, "E5")
        log_title = Text("Log", font_size=14, color=LOG_COLOR)
        self.place_at_grid(log_title, "D5")
        
        # Move ID-A from Alice to Bob
        self.play(id_a.animate.move_to(self.grid["C5"]), run_time=1.5)
        
        log_entry_1 = Text("ID-A", font_size=14, color=ID_COLOR)
        log_entry_1.move_to(self.grid["E5"] + UP * 0.3)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(log_box), FadeIn(log_title))
        self.play(Transform(id_a, log_entry_1))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # No locations or names are ever exchanged.
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(RED)
        
        cross_line1 = Line(LEFT*0.3, RIGHT*0.3, color=RED).rotate(PI/4)
        cross_line2 = Line(LEFT*0.3, RIGHT*0.3, color=RED).rotate(-PI/4)
        cross = VGroup(cross_line1, cross_line2)
        
        loc_text = Text("GPS/Location", font_size=16, color=RED)
        name_text = Text("Identity/Name", font_size=16, color=RED)
        
        loc_group = VGroup(loc_text, cross.copy())
        name_group = VGroup(name_text, cross.copy())
        
        self.place_at_grid(loc_group, "B4")
        self.place_at_grid(name_group, "C4")
        
        self.play(FadeIn(loc_group), FadeIn(name_group))
        self.play(Indicate(loc_group), Indicate(name_group))
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(FadeOut(loc_group), FadeOut(name_group))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # These secret handshakes stay only on your device.
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(LOG_COLOR)
        
        # Clock ticks again, send ID-B
        id_b = Text("ID-B", font_size=20, color=ID_COLOR)
        self.place_at_grid(id_b, "C2")
        
        log_entry_2 = Text("ID-B", font_size=14, color=ID_COLOR)
        log_entry_2.move_to(self.grid["E5"] + DOWN * 0.1)
        
        self.play(Rotate(clock_hand, angle=-TAU, about_point=clock_circle.get_center()), run_time=1)
        self.play(Write(id_b))
        self.play(id_b.animate.move_to(self.grid["C5"]), run_time=1.2)
        self.play(Transform(id_b, log_entry_2))
        
        # Emphasize storage is only on Bob's phone area
        self.play(Indicate(log_box), Indicate(bob_phone))
        self.wait(2)

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup content
        lecture_lines = [
            "If Alice tests positive, she voluntarily shares her seed.",
            "She only uploads seeds for her contagious days.",
            "The central server receives these diagnosis keys anonymously.",
            "The server acts like a public bulletin board.",
            "It never learns who Alice actually met."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Phase 2: The Diagnosis Key (1:00)", lecture_lines)

        # Assets Preparation
        # Alice Icon
        alice_circ = Circle(radius=0.4, color="#3498DB", fill_opacity=0.8)
        alice_label = Text("Alice", font_size=20).next_to(alice_circ, DOWN, buff=0.1)
        alice = VGroup(alice_circ, alice_label)
        self.place_at_grid(alice, "C2")

        # Diagnosis Status (+)
        plus_sign = Text("+", color=WHITE, font_size=36).move_to(alice_circ.get_center())

        # Seed Icon
        seed_box = RoundedRectangle(height=0.4, width=0.8, color="#E67E22", fill_opacity=1)
        seed_text = Text("Seed", font_size=16, color=BLACK).move_to(seed_box.get_center())
        seed_group = VGroup(seed_box, seed_text)

        # Cloud Server Icon
        c1 = Circle(radius=0.4, color="#FFFFFF", fill_opacity=0.8).shift(LEFT*0.3)
        c2 = Circle(radius=0.5, color="#FFFFFF", fill_opacity=0.8).shift(UP*0.2)
        c3 = Circle(radius=0.4, color="#FFFFFF", fill_opacity=0.8).shift(RIGHT*0.3)
        cloud = VGroup(c1, c2, c3)
        cloud_label = Text("Central Server", font_size=18).next_to(cloud, DOWN, buff=0.2)
        cloud_full = VGroup(cloud, cloud_label)
        self.place_at_grid(cloud_full, "C5")

        # Privacy labels
        no_id = Text("No Personal ID", font_size=14, color="#E74C3C")
        no_contacts = Text("No Contact List", font_size=14, color="#E74C3C")
        privacy_group = VGroup(no_id, no_contacts).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.1).next_to(cloud, UP, buff=0.2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # If Alice tests positive, she voluntarily shares her seed.
        self.play(FadeIn(alice))
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#3498DB"))
        self.play(
            alice_circ.animate.set_color("#E74C3C"),
            FadeIn(plus_sign)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # She only uploads seeds for her contagious days.
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#E67E22"))
        self.place_at_grid(seed_group, "C2", scale_factor=0.8)
        self.play(FadeIn(seed_group))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # The central server receives these diagnosis keys anonymously.
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#FFFFFF"))
        self.play(FadeIn(cloud_full))
        
        arrow = Arrow(start=self.grid["C2"] + RIGHT*0.5, end=self.grid["C5"] + LEFT*0.5, color=WHITE, buff=0.1)
        self.play(GrowArrow(arrow))
        self.play(
            seed_group.animate.move_to(cloud.get_center()).scale(0.7),
            run_time=1.5
        )

outline.topic: DP-3T: The Privacy-First Way to Trace Infections
outline.target_audience: University students in Computer Science or Public Health

sections.title: The Privacy Dilemma (0:45)
sections.content: Introduction to the conflict between effective contact tracing (needing to know who was near whom) and individual privacy (not wanting a central authority to track movements). Defines DP-3T (Decentralized Privacy-Preserving Proximity Tracing).
sections.example: Imagine 'Alice' and 'Bob' are walking in a park. Traditional tracing is like a spy following them with a map. DP-3T is like them wearing masks and whispering secret, temporary nicknames to each other that only they remember.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Digital Shredder (Hashing) (0:45)
sections.content: Explanation of Cryptographic Hash Functions and Seeds. Prerequisite knowledge needed to understand how IDs are generated without revealing the original user identity. Visualizing a 'One-Way Function' using a mathematical blender.
sections.example: Show a 'Secret Seed' (a unique number) going into a machine. The machine outputs 'EphIDs' (Ephemeral IDs). You can get the IDs from the seed, but you can't guess the seed just by looking at the IDs—like turning fruit into a smoothie.

sections.title: Phase 1: The Daily Handshake (1:00)
sections.content: How devices interact via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE). Every 15 minutes, the device generates a new EphID. Devices record the EphIDs they hear from others in a local, private log.
sections.example: Alice’s phone broadcasts 'ID-Alpha'. Bob’s phone hears 'ID-Alpha' and writes it in its private notebook. 15 minutes later, Alice’s phone changes to 'ID-Beta'. Bob’s notebook now has a list of random codes, but no names or GPS locations.

sections.title: Phase 2: The Diagnosis Key (1:00)
sections.content: What happens when someone tests positive. The infected user uploads only their 'Secret Seed' (Diagnosis Key) for the specific days they were contagious to a central server. The server does NOT know who the user is or who they met.
sections.example: Alice tests positive. She voluntarily clicks 'Upload'. Only her 'Secret Seed' for Tuesday goes to the cloud. The cloud acts like a public bulletin board where she pins her seed for everyone to see.

sections.title: Phase 3: Local Matching & Alert (1:00)
sections.content: Every user's phone periodically downloads new 'Diagnosis Keys' from the server. The phone locally regenerates the potential EphIDs from those seeds and compares them with its own local notebook. If there is a match, the user is notified.
sections.example: Bob’s phone downloads Alice’s 'Secret Seed'. It runs the 'Blender' math locally to see what IDs that seed would produce. It sees 'ID-Alpha' in the results and 'ID-Alpha' in its own notebook. Bob’s phone flashes a red alert: 'You were near someone who tested positive!'

sections.title: Conclusion: The Decentralized Win (0:30)
sections.content: Summary of why this is secure: The server never knows who was exposed, and users only share data if they are sick. The power of the algorithm lies in the fact that the 'matching' happens on the user's device, not the cloud.
sections.example: A final graphic showing the Central Server holding only a list of random seeds, while Alice and Bob remain anonymous dots on a map that the server cannot see.

[VideoCritic][section_1] Problem: Alice (C2) is positioned too close to the lecture notes on the left, leading to visual crowding and potential overlap with long text lines. Fix: Line 66: self.place_at_grid(alice, 'D3', scale_factor=0.8) (line=66, object=alice)

[VideoCritic][section_1] Problem: Alice (Row C) and Bob (Row D) are vertically misaligned, resulting in a diagonal, unbalanced layout relative to the central elements. Fix: Line 67: self.place_at_grid(bob, 'D5', scale_factor=0.8) (line=67, object=bob)

[VideoCritic][section_1] Problem: The DP-3T title uses a default scale, causing a jarring visual transition when replacing the 0.8-scaled shield and central eye assets. Fix: Line 151: self.place_at_grid(dp3t_title, 'C4', scale_factor=0.8) (line=151, object=dp3t_title)

[VideoCritic][section_2] Problem: Vertical underutilization of the grid. There is a large gap between the seed_group (A4) and the blender (C3-D5), pushing the bottom elements (hex IDs) too close to the screen edge. Fix: Line 72: self.place_in_area(blender, 'B3', 'D5', scale_factor=1.2) (line=72, object=blender)

[VideoCritic][section_2] Problem: The red cross is positioned at the bottom of the blender's bounding box (D4), which looks visually unbalanced and misaligned with the blender's center. Fix: Line 126: self.place_at_grid(cross, 'C4') (line=126, object=cross)

[VideoCritic][section_2] Problem: The current bottom-heavy layout leaves insufficient margin for the temporary IDs at the bottom of the frame, risking cut-off text on some displays. Fix: Line 72: self.place_in_area(blender, 'B3', 'D5', scale_factor=1.2) (line=72, object=blender)

[VideoCritic][section_3] Problem: The Bluetooth range (bt_range) is assigned to area A1-F6, which covers the entire animation grid, causing the circular visual to clip at the edges and visually overwhelm other elements. Fix: Line 79: self.place_in_area(bt_range, 'B2', 'E5', scale_factor=1.0) (line=79, object=bt_range)

[VideoCritic][section_3] Problem: The temporary ID labels (id_a, id_b) overlap alice_phone at C2, making it difficult to distinguish the ID text from the phone asset. Fix: Line 99: self.place_at_grid(id_a, 'C2', scale_factor=0.6); Line 156: self.place_at_grid(id_b, 'C2', scale_factor=0.6) (line=99, object=id_a)

[VideoCritic][section_3] Problem: The GPS/location and name groups (loc_group, name_group) are vertically stacked at B4 and C4 directly under the clock (A4), creating a crowded central column. Fix: Line 141: self.place_at_grid(loc_group, 'B3', scale_factor=0.75); Line 142: self.place_at_grid(name_group, 'C3', scale_factor=0.75) (line=141, object=loc_group)

[VideoCritic][section_4] Problem: The main visual elements (alice and cloud_full) are underscaled for the 6x6 grid, resulting in poor space utilization and making details like the seed less prominent. Fix: Line 62: self.place_at_grid('alice', 'C2', scale_factor=1.3) (line=62, object=alice)

[VideoCritic][section_4] Problem: The label 'Bulletin Board' is a long, two-word string that may appear cramped or risk clipping when the cloud_full object is confined to a single grid cell at C5. Fix: Line 79: self.place_in_area('cloud_full', 'C5', 'C6', scale_factor=1.3) (line=79, object=cloud_full)

[VideoCritic][section_4] Problem: The seed_group asset is currently too small (scale 0.8) to maintain visual impact when moving towards the larger, upscaled cloud_full icon. Fix: Line 99: self.place_at_grid('seed_group', 'C2', scale_factor=1.1) (line=99, object=seed_group)

[VideoCritic][section_5] Problem: The blender_group (B2) overlaps with the top boundary of the phone area (B1-E2), creating a cluttered appearance. Fix: Line 98: self.place_at_grid(blender_group, 'A2', scale_factor=0.8) (line=98, object=blender_group)

[VideoCritic][section_5] Problem: The alert_group (C2) overlaps with the generated IDs (D2) when the alert is triggered, obscuring the matching logic. Fix: Line 144: self.place_at_grid(alert_group, 'B2') (line=144, object=alert_group)

[VideoCritic][section_5] Problem: The local_log (D5) is positioned too far from the phone (B1-E2), making the visual comparison between local and generated IDs feel disconnected. Fix: Line 127: self.place_at_grid(local_log, 'D4', scale_factor=1.0) (line=127, object=local_log)

[VideoCritic][section_6] Problem: The trust_text overlaps with the map container and server metadata due to its large scale and position in row E. Fix: Line 113: self.place_in_area(trust_text, 'F2', 'F5', scale_factor=1.0) (line=113, object=trust_text)

[VideoCritic][section_6] Problem: Labels within the user_group ('Personal Identity', 'Alice / Bob') are too close to the map_bg area directly below. Fix: Line 71: self.place_at_grid(user_group, 'B5', scale_factor=0.8) (line=71, object=user_group)

[VideoCritic][section_6] Problem: The server_group details ('List of Seeds', hashes) risk crowding the central separator and bottom text at full scale. Fix: Line 64: self.place_at_grid(server_group, 'B2', scale_factor=0.8) (line=64, object=server_group)
